name: wisebits-chat
description: Wisebits Chat Application - Full Stack Chat with Stories

scripts.build: pnpm build:frontend && pnpm build:backend && mkdir -p backend/frontend-build && cp -r frontend/build/* backend/frontend-build/
scripts.test:e2e:playwright: cd frontend && pnpm build && pnpm preview & sleep 5 && pnpm test:e2e; kill %1
scripts.test:e2e:bdd: cd frontend && pnpm build && pnpm preview & sleep 5 && pnpm test:bdd; kill %1
scripts.start: pnpm build && pnpm docker:build && pnpm docker:up
scripts.start:dev: docker-compose up mongo -d && concurrently "pnpm dev:backend" "pnpm dev:frontend" --names "backend,frontend" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta"
